rules.objective: Be the first player to reach the required lore total.
rules.gameplay: Players ink cards for resources, play characters and actions, quest for lore, challenge opposing characters, and use card effects to control the race.
keyRules: Constructed deck of at least 60 cards.
Cards may be used as ink resources.
Challenges remove or weaken opposing characters.
First to the lore target wins.

strategy.basic: Curve ink carefully; missing early ink can lose tempo, but inking a key late-game card may remove your win condition.
strategy.intermediate: Track the cards, suits, or resources that control the next legal plays, and avoid giving opponents a simple route to their scoring condition.
strategy.advanced: Use memory and tempo to force opponents into inefficient plays while preserving cards or resources that complete your own plan.
